name: Claude for Google Workspace
desc: Claude add-on inside Google Docs, Sheets and Slides
desc_zh: 嵌入 Google 文档、表格和演示的 Claude 插件
solves: Writing in Docs means hopping out to a chatbot and pasting back; Claude now works inside the open file.
solves_zh: 在 Google 文档里写作要切到聊天机器人再贴回来，现在可直接在文件内用 Claude。
best_for: A slide deck is half-written and you need the remaining bullets in the file itself.
best_for_zh: 演示文稿只写了一半，想直接在文件里补齐剩余要点。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://www.anthropic.com/news/product and https://claude.com/resources/arti）。 Public beta on all paid Claude plans; ships with new Docs, Sheets and Slides connectors (beta). Second source is not independent media. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：嵌在办公软件里的助手，与账本对 Grok for Word、ChatGPT for Excel 的分类一致。 首次公开日期来源：https://claude.com/resources/articles/claude-now-works-in-google-docs-sheets-and-slides
